mizzu-sushi.description: Visual identity for a Japanese restaurant in Siqueira Campos, in the countryside of Paraná, Brazil. The name comes from mizu (水), Japanese for water: the link between water and seafood, the base of Japanese cuisine, guides the brand. An adaptation of The Great Wave off Kanagawa (Hokusai, 1830) evokes the Japanese heritage and brings the energy of the ocean to every application.

hero.alt: Mizzu Sushi logo over the Great Wave in dark red

blocks.alt: Four versions of the Mizzu Sushi logo in red, black, cream and white
blocks.caption: Signatures

blocks.label: Concept
blocks.text: Mizu (水) means water. The word became the starting point: water as the link between the ocean and the plate. The ideogram takes the role of the symbol, the widely spaced serif typography brings the calm of tradition, and the red with a near-black brown recalls Japanese lacquer and ceramics.

blocks.label: Applications
blocks.text: The system extends across every customer touchpoint: the band on delivery trays, the chopstick sleeve, tote bag, business card, uniform and the Instagram profile. On every piece, the wave and the seal appear sparingly, letting the red do the work.

jabutibar.description: Visual identity for an open-air bar in Itaporanga, in the countryside of São Paulo state, Brazil. JabutiBar celebrates life outdoors, quality food and drink, and local culture. The brand comes from the nature that surrounds the place and the light atmosphere of the countryside, translating a philosophy of welcome and celebration.

blocks.text: A place where worries vanish in the breeze and laughter echoes among the trees. The tortoise, in no rush, became the symbol of that rhythm. Foliage greens, a paper cream and a rounded lettering give the brand the relaxed tone of the countryside, and the leaf illustrations bring the forest into every piece.

move.tagline: More technique. More control. More movement.
move.description: Visual identity for Move+, a conditioning and strength training center. A slanted logo, in dark olive green with a lime-green +, conveys speed and progress, and is applied from the icon on a watch to a T-shirt, with a direct voice that promises more technique, more control and more movement.

blocks.label: About the brand
blocks.text: Move+ is a conditioning and strength training center. It offers professional guidance, focus on goals and a path built on consistency. The brand translates that into slanted letters that keep moving forward and a lime-green + sign: always one step more.

blocks.alt: Woman in a push-up position on a studio floor, with the Move+ logo and the line Conditioning and Strength
blocks.caption: Cover

blocks.label: Logo
blocks.text: The logo is fully slanted, with diagonal cuts in the letters, to give speed. The dark olive green brings firmness and the lime-green + is the only spot of color, the sign of progress. The version with “Training center” goes with the brand across materials.

items.alt: Move+ logo in olive green with a lime-green + and the line Training center, on a white background
items.caption: Light version

items.alt: Move+ logo in white with a lime-green + and the line Training center, on a dark background
items.caption: Dark version

blocks.alt: M+ icon in white on olive green and in dark olive on lime green
blocks.caption: Icon

blocks.label: Icon
blocks.text: The icon reduces the brand to the M and the +: a slanted shape, in motion, that fits in an app, on a watch or in a profile picture.
More technique. More control. More movement.

blocks.alt: Move+ logo in light and dark versions next to an athlete with a kettlebell, with the name outlined and repeated over the photo
blocks.caption: Brand over photography

blocks.label: Colors
blocks.text: Dark olive green gives the base, sober and firm, and lime green comes in as energy, in small doses.

blocks.alt: Athlete leaning on a slam ball during a workout, in a gym
title: More than training.
It is transformation.
blocks.text: Here you find professional guidance, focus on your goals and a path built on consistency. Here, every step forward is an achievement — physical, mental and personal.

title: Training with purpose.
Results with precision.
blocks.text: At Move+, every movement is planned to take you further. With technical guidance and attention to your needs, we turn effort into progress — with efficiency, safety and real results.

blocks.label: Applications
blocks.text: The brand takes shape on the everyday gear: what you wear, carry and use on your wrist. The logo and the icon change size and background without losing presence.

topfit.tagline: Supplements to help you reach the top.
topfit.description: Complete visual identity for TOPFIT, a concept supplements brand from Ribeirão Preto (SP) that wants to represent attitude, beyond selling products. Raw, blocky letters, an intense red and an arrow-shaped icon that goes up hold the brand together, from the e-commerce to the packaging.

hero.alt: Black T-shirt with the red TOPFIT logo label

blocks.label: About the brand
blocks.text: TOPFIT was not born to be just another supplements store. It runs a physical store, its own e-commerce, marketplaces and distribution, and it sells more than product: it sells attitude, curation and positioning. A brand with its own voice: provocative, raw, direct and authentic.

blocks.label: Scope
blocks.text: The work went through the brand’s strategic build: logo, typography, color palette, concept, icon, variations and tone of voice, always direct, high contrast and built on the rebel archetype. From there, the identity moved on to the e-commerce, the packaging and the digital content, prints and physical media.

blocks.alt: Main TOPFIT logos in red: primary logo, arrow icon and logo with tagline
blocks.caption: Main logos

blocks.alt: TOPFIT logo variations: box logo, vertical, isometric and stylized
blocks.caption: Variations

blocks.label: Logo
blocks.text: The logo is a visual statement: the name in its purest form, in raw, blocky, heavy letters. We removed even the counters of the “O” and the “P” to intensify the sense of a block, and the type has almost no letter spacing. With those decisions, the only color that fit was red, for its visceral and brave nature.

blocks.alt: TOPFIT logo in white over a red-to-wine gradient, with the tagline Supplements to help you reach the top
blocks.caption: Logo and tagline

blocks.text: Symbols that shout, not whisper.

blocks.alt: TOPFIT icon: a white isometric arrow over a red background, with construction lines
blocks.caption: Icon

blocks.label: Icon
blocks.text: Built from the brand’s “T”, symmetrically distorted, split into two blocks and tilted by 30 degrees, it creates an isometric view that recalls a solid corner. It can be read as a disguised arrow pointing up, the corner of an e-commerce box, or a geometric seal that marks territory.

blocks.label: Colors
blocks.text: Intense red (#C21819) is the main tone: strength, movement and power. White and light gray give room to breathe and legibility, especially on digital, while wine and black come in sparingly, as colors of quiet strength.

blocks.label: Typography
blocks.text: Gasoek One, ultra-bold with straight terminals, imposes on headlines, taglines and statements. When the content needs to breathe, Figtree comes in, versatile and legible, for descriptions and running text.

items.alt: Specimens of the Gasoek One typeface in red: the font name and the alphabet, numbers and symbols

blocks.alt: Type specimens of TOPFIT’s typefaces: Gasoek One as primary and Figtree as secondary
blocks.caption: Typography

blocks.label: Applications
blocks.text: The brand’s variations change context without losing strength: from the feed to a video, from a stamp to a print. The box logo carries TOPFIT like a flag, the isometric version adds movement and the icon signs whatever is needed.

items.alt: Red packaging with the TOPFIT logo in white
items.caption: Packaging

items.alt: Black hoodie with the isometric TOPFIT logo in white

blocks.text: We sell supplements. But also attitude.

blocks.alt: Several phones showing the TOPFIT online store, with category, product and campaign pages
blocks.caption: E-commerce on mobile

blocks.label: E-commerce
blocks.text: On the brand’s own e-commerce, built on Shopify, the experience is fast, safe and no-nonsense, from the click to the result. The look is high contrast: black background, heavy type and red as the point of action.

blocks.alt: Laptop showing the TOPFIT online store home, with the tagline over a workout photo
blocks.caption: Site home

blocks.label: Packaging
blocks.text: I designed all the packaging for the brand’s own products. The brand becomes the label: raw typography, geometric icons and red as the protagonist, in contrast with the minimalism of white, so TOPFIT stands out on any shelf.

frias-constantino.description: Visual identity for Frias Constantino Advocacia, a tax law firm in Tatuapé, São Paulo. An owl in an engraving line, an FC monogram of overlapping initials and a palette of green, sand and gold communicate precision before the very first conversation.

hero.alt: Spine of a green book with the Frias Constantino Advocacia logo in gold

blocks.text: A brand built with the same rigor it stands for.

blocks.label: Concept
blocks.text: Every choice, from the line to the typography, answers to an intention: to communicate precision before the very first conversation.

blocks.alt: Frias Constantino Advocacia logo in green on a sand background
blocks.caption: Logo

blocks.label: The owl
blocks.text: The owl crosses cultures as a symbol of wisdom. It is the companion of Athena, the Greek goddess of strategy. But what makes it right for this brand is its behavior: it sees where others do not, flies in absolute silence and acts with surgical precision. Observation, discretion and precision: the same triad that defines good tax law. Drawn in an engraving line, it recalls the legal and editorial tradition; in flight, it conveys a practice that does not wait for the problem: it anticipates.

blocks.alt: Six versions of the brand owl: in flight from the front, in flight from the side, perched, and with the Frias Constantino name
blocks.caption: Owl family

blocks.label: Monogram
blocks.text: The FC monogram is born from the overlap of the initials, not side by side, but crossed. The F rests on the structure of the C, and the C embraces the stem of the F. It is a construction that only works because the two shapes were drawn for each other, just as a good argument only holds when each point ties into the next. The design comes from the tradition of seal monograms: the stamp that, long before digital signatures, validated documents and vouched for what was written. On its own, the monogram is the most condensed form of the brand: where the full name does not fit, it answers.

items.alt: FC monogram embossed on a green background
items.caption: Embossed monogram

items.alt: Owl perched on the FC monogram, in green on a sand background
items.caption: Owl on the monogram

blocks.label: Colors
blocks.text: The palette starts from green, the color of stability, balance and prosperity, in a family that goes from deep to serene, holding the brand with the same constancy expected from good counsel. Over it, sand and browns bring the warmth of paper and leather, a repertoire inherited from the world of documents and legal libraries. Gold, always in a precise dose, is the point of value: it appears where the brand wants to lead the eye, like a thread of emphasis amid sobriety.
No color shouts; all of them assert.

blocks.label: Applications
blocks.text: The identity takes shape on paper, fabric and screen: gold in relief over deep green, the owl as a watermark and the monogram as a signature, where the full name does not fit.

tasty-nutrition.description: Visual identity for Tasty Nutrition, a premium supplements brand rooted in health, well-being and lifestyle. Instead of the category’s aggressive look, a script lettering inside a soft container, a palette that comes from the pantry and a voice that invites rather than demands.

hero.alt: Cream Tasty logotype over two smiling women lying on the grass

blocks.text: It was all in the name.

blocks.label: Concept
blocks.text: Tasty is not a word about performance, strength or pushing limits. It is a word about pleasure. The goal was a brand you could feel in your hand: with volume, weight and the softness of a surface that gives when pressed. Less like a symbol and more like food.

blocks.alt: Tasty logo, cream script lettering inside a cocoa-brown container with concave sides, on a vanilla background
blocks.caption: Logo

blocks.label: Positioning
blocks.text: A premium supplements brand, rooted in health, well-being and lifestyle. Performance is there, but it does not drive the language. The core audience is adults over 35 with busy routines, people who have already tried things they could not keep up: for them, taste and convenience matter as much as the formula.

blocks.label: Construction
blocks.text: The container comes from the intersection of circles and ellipses. Its concave sides and flared tips create a shape under tension, full in the center and squeezed at the edges, as if pressed from the outside in. The lettering came next, drawn on a grid of slanted lines, with a continuous gesture and soft terminals.

items.alt: Circles and ellipses that give rise to the brand container
items.caption: Circles and ellipses

items.alt: Grid of slanted lines the lettering was drawn on
items.caption: Lettering grid

items.alt: Tasty lettering with Nutrition, cream on plum
items.caption: Lettering

blocks.label: Colors
blocks.text: The palette comes from the pantry, not the lab. Mint, pistachio and avocado anchor the brand in warm greens, far from the clinical pharmacy green, on a vanilla base. Plum, hazelnut, chocolate and cocoa translate what is inside the tub, and gold leaf, in fine lines and details, carries the premium feel.
A good supplement is the one you take every day.

blocks.label: Typography
blocks.text: Ranade for headlines and highlights: geometric, with clean terminals, it balances the hand-drawn lettering with a rational structure. Instrument Sans for text and information, from captions to the nutrition table. The lettering never becomes a typeface: it is a signature.

blocks.label: Graphic system
blocks.text: The shape that holds the lettering also stands on its own, as a frame, a tag or a crop. Repeated in a grid, it becomes the brand pattern. The script can also bleed off the edge: since the letters are unique, Tasty stays recognizable even when half of it is cut off.

blocks.alt: Plum Tasty lettering cut off at the edges, next to a photo with a plum bottle and a tennis ball
blocks.caption: Bleeding lettering

blocks.label: Photography
blocks.text: Real people, in real movement, in everyday situations. Faces that show pleasure and rest, not strain. Natural light, sky, soft shadows and food nearby; no gym interiors, power poses or dark backgrounds.

karolinne-hartung.description: Visual identity and website for psychoanalyst Karolinne Hartung, in Campinas, Brazil. A mature, welcoming brand that steps away from the clinical look of healthcare to embrace the deeply human side of psychoanalysis: a serif logotype with a floral icon, a KH monogram and a palette of warm tones.

hero.alt: Karolinne Hartung logotype in cream, with a floral icon, on a bordeaux background

blocks.label: Concept
blocks.text: The idea is to create a mature, confident visual identity that steps away from the traditional clinical look and embraces the deeply human side of psychoanalysis.

blocks.label: Logotype
blocks.text: The Karolinne Hartung logotype joins elegance and warmth through a serif typeface that blends the stability of a classic font with the organic fluidity of the italic, reflecting the movement of the psychoanalytic process itself. The first name is set in roman and the surname in italic, with a floral icon beside it; “psicanalista” appears in uppercase, sans serif and widely tracked.

blocks.alt: Karolinne Hartung logotype in bordeaux, with a floral icon and the word psicanalista, on a sand background
blocks.caption: Logotype

blocks.alt: Three vertical logotype versions: cream on bordeaux, bordeaux on white and cream on deep moss green
blocks.caption: Versions

items.alt: Horizontal logotype in cream on a deep moss green background
Stacked logotype in cream on a terracotta background

blocks.label: Colors
blocks.text: This palette was chosen strategically to move away from the cold, overly clinical tones traditional in healthcare. The goal is a visual environment that conveys warmth, depth and active listening right away.

blocks.label: Icons
blocks.text: The conscious awakening of the mind, the blossoming of self-knowledge and the recovery of fluidity in life. Three circular icons give shape to each of these movements.

items.alt: Awaken icon: a sand circle with a star shape in bordeaux

blocks.caption: Pattern

blocks.label: Monogram
blocks.text: The “KH” monogram was created to work as the brand’s signature seal, bringing a sense of exclusivity, closeness and haute couture to the visual identity. More than a simple abbreviation, it acts as the brand’s intimate signature, visually translating the essence of the psychoanalytic process. It is ideal for more delicate uses, such as social media avatars, stamps, watermarks or the site footer.

blocks.text: Deep care for real transformation.
